summary: This is a Makefile target named 'helloWorld' that, when invoked with the make command, will print the text 'Hello world' to the console. The @ symbol suppresses echoing the command itself, so you only see the output message, not the echo command that produced it.

explanations.1: This creates a target called 'helloWorld' — a named task that make can execute when you run 'make helloWorld'.
explanations.2: The @echo command prints 'Hello world' to the screen; the @ prefix tells make to run this quietly without showing the command line itself.
